summary: Becerra called for a Gaza ceasefire, hostage release, and a two-state path at the 2024 World Health Assembly, but when asked in May 2026 whether Israel's actions were genocide, he criticized Netanyahu and demanded accountability without affirming the term. CAIR Action endorsed him in the general phase; Vote for Peace rated him neutral. In an October 2026 debate he called the US-Israeli war in Iran illegal, though the reporting noted it criticized form rather than the crime itself.
